entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi, Charlie... I hope you can help. I need to... I need to return something. It's the VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, no, it's not broken. It's... it's just... a lot has happened. We bought it as a gift, but there was a family emergency right after it arrived.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Can you tell me what happened?

My husband was supposed to go on a last-minute military deployment, and we bought this for him to use. But... he ended up in the hospital instead. He needed an unexpected surgery and we've just been dealing with all of that. The box is just sitting here, and honestly, I've been a loyal customer for years and I could really use the money back right now.
That sounds incredibly stressful. I completely understand. Thank you for sharing that with me. Let me just pull up your order information and check the policy for you. One moment.
Okay, thank you. I really hope you can help.

Alright, I have your order right here. I see you received the VeloBand just seven days ago. According to our policy, you have 90 days from the delivery date to make a return. So, you are well within the timeframe.
Oh, really? So it's not a problem?

Not a problem at all. Given the circumstances and that you're well inside the 90-day window, I can process this return for a full refund for you right now. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to the email address on file. You should see it in the next few minutes.
Wow. That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Charlie. You have no idea how much this helps. I was so worried.
You're very welcome. It's the least we can do. I hope your husband has a swift and easy recovery. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for being so kind.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a better rest of your day.
